FinWise AI

A personal financial decision intelligence platform that analyzes income, expenses, savings, debt, and financial goals. It integrates Google Gemini AI to evaluate alternatives, assess risks and trade-offs, and generate personalized, explainable recommendations. Built with Supabase Authentication, PostgreSQL, Row Level Security, and secure backend APIs.
